_doc: Blind labels for the cohesion gate measurement, written 2026-09-03 from titles and 140-char snippets only, BEFORE the judge ran on these clusters. One reader (Claude Fable 5.1 in the session), not ground truth. Rubric: event identity, not genre -- angles, reactions, analysis, follow-ups and market reaction to ONE underlying event are one event; articles sharing only a place, person, organisation or topic are different events. n_events = distinct events in the cluster; strays = ids NOT in the dominant (largest) event. Singletons are not judged and not labelled.
